promptSet: Create an original editorial illustration for the named article using sophisticated contemporary magazine illustration, geometric cut-paper shapes with subtle screen-print grain, crisp silhouettes and layered depth. Use a wide 16:10 landscape composition with a strong central focal point and safe crop margins. Palette: deep navy, clear red, muted sky blue, warm cream and charcoal. No text, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, photorealism or identifiable real person.
